name: object_forge_flow
description: Prompt to game-ready 3D object in three card stages: concept (image-gen z-image — one subject render), lift (img-to-mesh trellis2-native — textured mesh, repair knobs at card defaults), remesh (quad-remesh — quad topology for game engines; textures do NOT survive the remesher). WHAT it produces: the lift's textured tri mesh AND the remesher's quad mesh from one prompt line. HOW it runs: all three stages are card=, so the {flow:} door submits ONE merged run (image-upscale's 2026-10-04 shape); agents can also drive the cards one at a time through the queue door. Craft surfaces: {model:} door, the bench, or the object_forge POST tool.

prompt.description: Required. The object — one clear subject, plain background reads best (a single prop on white beats a busy scene).

target_quads.description: Quad budget for the remesh stage (0-200000, default 50000). Lower for hero-adjacent density, higher for detail props.

image_model.description: Concept generator family: z-image (default) or krea-2.
